properties.site-address: Ebbsfleet Central including car parks and land east of International Way
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Land to the north of the site is former municipal landfill. This area of the site will be unsuitable for residential use due to landfill gas emissions and ground stabilisation issues.. Development of upto 789,550sq.m gross floorspace comprising employment, residential, hotel and leisure uses supporting retail & community facilities & provision of car parking, open space, roads & infrastructure.
